question: **Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.** Arunima is the __apple of her mother’s eye__.

options.text: A person of whom her mother is extremely fond and proud

solution:
The correct answer is: **A person of whom her mother is extremely fond and proud.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom '**apple of one's eye**' means someone or something that is cherished and highly valued. (कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु जिसे पोषित किया जाता है और जिसे अत्यधिक महत्व दिया जाता है)
